title: Lagged BTC-versus-Nasdaq relative strength for BTC long or cash
thesis: Positive Bitcoin outperformance versus the Nasdaq Composite over sixty-three paired business days may identify crypto-specific leadership in which next-week BTC exposure has better risk-adjusted economics than unconditional buy-and-hold.
mechanism: On the final valid Nasdaq business date of each ISO week, pair the latest sixty-three Nasdaq closes with BTC complete UTC-day closes on the same dates. Subtract the Nasdaq cumulative return from the BTC cumulative return, make the value available no earlier than the observation date plus one calendar day at 00:00 UTC, and hold BTC from the first eligible H1 open only when the spread is strictly positive; otherwise hold zero-yield cash until the next weekly factor update.
